describe.description: The creature is a large quadrupedal mammal shown in right-facing profile standing on a small patch of ground with pebbles and sparse grass. It has the overall body, head, and limbs of a brown bear covered in dense, shaggy brown fur that is lighter tan on the muzzle, chest and flank, and darker on the legs. From the center of its forehead projects a single long, glossy, dark reddish-brown to black segmented horn that curves upward and backward. Covering its entire back from just behind the shoulders to above the hindquarters is a large, domed, glossy exoskeleton-like shell that is dark reddish-brown with black shading, appearing smooth and reflective.
